Materials and Methods

The separation was performed on a Waters XBridge C18 (150 x 4.6 mm, 3 um).

Mobile phase A: water with 0.1% formic acid. Mobile phase B: acetonitrile.

The flow rate was 0.8 mL/min and runtime was 12 min.
